message.content: {"caption":"Three-panel scatter plot comparing accuracy and inference latency for Base, Base + Reranker, and Memory-R1 (GRPO) across F1, B1, and J.","description":"Three side-by-side scatter plots show accuracy (%) on the vertical axes and latency (s) on logarithmic horizontal axes. The panels are labelled F1 (↑), B1 (↑), and J (↑). The legend maps blue to Base, orange to Base + Reranker, and green to Memory-R1 (GRPO); circles denote p50 and triangles denote p95. In each panel, the circle and triangle for a pipeline lie at approximately the same accuracy, while the triangle is farther right, indicating greater p95 than p50 latency. Memory-R1 has the highest accuracy and the lowest latency in all three panels; Base has the lowest accuracy, while Base + Reranker is between Base and Memory-R1 in accuracy and has substantially higher latency than Base. Approximate plotted accuracy values are about 30.5, 33, and 45 for F1; 22, 25, and 37.5 for B1; and 45.5, 60, and 62 for J, for Base, Base + Reranker, and Memory-R1 respectively.
